tools.name: contact_semero
tools.description: SEMERO contacts: 911@semero.ua, WhatsApp/phone +380638431010, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, works online. Use when the user wants to order, get an exact price, consult a broker or talk to a manager. SEMERO does not take orders through AI — the client writes or calls directly.
